IncidentDef.label: veil descends
IncidentDef.letterText: The sky over your colony has turned the colour of a bruise. Someone - or something - has drawn a curtain over this place, sealing it off from the world outside.\n\nCursed spirits can feel it. For as long as the veil holds they will keep pushing through, a few at a time, and no help is coming through that sky. Hold until it lifts.

IncidentDef.label: sukuna's finger unearthed
IncidentDef.letterText: Something has surfaced near your colony: a withered, blackened finger the length of a forearm, humming with more cursed energy than a whole grade 1 spirit.\n\nOne of the King of Curses' twenty fingers. Curses have already converged on it - they always do. Take it and a sorcerer can swallow it for a terrible surge of power, at a price. Leave it, and the things it called are still out there.
